# FastMarchingTopoPlot

Written by Roland Blok. Origin: https://github.com/rolandblok/FastMarchingTopoPlot

The adaptation of the Fast Marching algorithm to Rust is in `crates/vectorio-core/src/topo.rs`. The original JavaScript is not included or run within the application. Origin, differences and verification: `docs/referencia/topografia.md`.

The original license is retained in its entirety in `UNLICENSE`.
